speaker: INTERVIEWER
line: Hi, Allison. Nice to meet you. So, what do you do?

speaker: ALLISON
line: Hi! Nice to meet you too. I’m a doctor. I work at a hospital near my house.

speaker: INTERVIEWER
line: Oh, nice. Is your family in medicine too?

speaker: ALLISON
line: No! My brother is a teacher. Very different.

speaker: INTERVIEWER
line: A doctor and a teacher. Busy family!

speaker: ALLISON
line: Yes, very busy!

speaker: INTERVIEWER
line: Hello, Mike. What do you do?

speaker: MIKE
line: I’m a farmer. I work outside most days.

speaker: INTERVIEWER
line: Do you like it?

speaker: MIKE
line: Yes, I do. My wife works in town. She’s a receptionist.

speaker: INTERVIEWER
line: So you’re the farmer in the family.

speaker: MIKE
line: That’s right.

speaker: INTERVIEWER
line: Hi, John. Are you a taxi driver?

speaker: JOHN
line: No, that’s my friend Carlos. I’m an office worker.

speaker: INTERVIEWER
line: Ah, okay. Where do you work?

speaker: JOHN
line: In an office downtown. I’m there from Monday to Friday.

speaker: INTERVIEWER
line: Got it. Office worker.

speaker: JOHN
line: Exactly.

speaker: INTERVIEWER
line: Hi, Lisa. You work in a restaurant, right?

speaker: LISA
line: Yes. My brother is a chef there, but I’m a waitress.

speaker: INTERVIEWER
line: Do you work together a lot?

speaker: LISA
line: Almost every day. He cooks, and I take the food to the tables.

speaker: INTERVIEWER
line: Sounds busy.

speaker: LISA
line: It is, especially at night.

speaker: INTERVIEWER
line: Hello, Bryan. What’s your job?

speaker: BRYAN
line: I’m a salesclerk. I work in a small shop.

speaker: INTERVIEWER
line: What do you sell?

speaker: BRYAN
line: Clothes, mostly. My dad is a farmer, so our jobs are completely different.

speaker: INTERVIEWER
line: Very different!

speaker: BRYAN
line: Yes, but I like my job.
